subject: crab

A wide, knobbly shell in brick red speckled with orange and cream, eyes on stalks, eight jointed walking legs with pointed tips, and claws with dark tips and little teeth on the pinchers. A tiny barnacle and a strand of seaweed cling to the back of its shell.
